nodes.description: Constant public MAX_OWNER_COUNT = 50, upper bound on owner count used by validRequirement.
mapping(uint => Transaction) public transactions; stores destination, value, data and executed flag per transaction id.
mapping(uint => mapping(address => bool)) public confirmations; records per-owner confirmations per transaction id.
mapping(address => bool) public isOwner; membership set controlling access to wallet-management functions.
address[] public owners; dynamic array of owner addresses.
uint public required; number of confirmations needed to execute a transaction.
uint public transactionCount; monotonically increasing transaction id counter.
uint public dailyLimit; wei withdrawable per day without multisig confirmation.
uint public lastDay; timestamp of the last daily-limit window reset.
uint public spentToday; amount already withdrawn in the current daily window.
Caller-supplied address used for owner checks, onlyWallet checks and confirmation bookkeeping.
Block timestamp exposed as now, used to reset the daily limit window and to compute the max withdrawable amount.
txi.destination.call.value(txi.value)(txi.data) low-level external call in MultiSigWallet.executeTransaction; effect ordering allows reentrancy.
txi.destination.call.value(txi.value)(txi.data) low-level external call in MultiSigWalletWithDailyLimit.executeTransaction, reachable without confirmations when under the daily limit.
spentToday += txi.value in the daily-limit execution path; unchecked arithmetic on the daily spending accumulator.
spentToday -= txi.value rollback on failed execution; can underflow if state was manipulated by reentrancy.
spentToday + amount > dailyLimit || spentToday + amount < spentToday overflow guard inside isUnderLimit.
now > lastDay + 24 hours comparison controlling daily-window reset in isUnderLimit.
transactionCount += 1 in addTransaction; unchecked counter increment.
owners.length -= 1 in removeOwner; unchecked array length decrement.
count += 1 while tallying confirmations in isConfirmed; unchecked counter increment.
to - from array sizing arithmetic in getTransactionIds; underflows when to < from.
now > lastDay + 24 hours and dailyLimit - spentToday arithmetic in calcMaxWithdraw.
payable fallback function that emits Deposit(msg.sender, msg.value) on non-zero value.
Constructor initialising owners, isOwner map and required confirmation count, guarded by validRequirement.
Adds a new owner; onlyWallet + ownerDoesNotExist + notNull + validRequirement guarded.
Removes an owner by swapping with the last array element, shrinking owners and adjusting required when needed.
Replaces an existing owner with a new owner, updating owners array and isOwner flags.
Changes the required confirmation count; onlyWallet + validRequirement guarded.
Public entry point that adds a transaction and immediately confirms it as msg.sender.
Records msg.sender's confirmation and then attempts executeTransaction.
Clears msg.sender's confirmation for a not-yet-executed transaction.
MultiSigWallet.executeTransaction: marks executed, performs the low-level call, and rolls back the flag on failure.
Constant function counting confirmations from owners until required is reached.
Internal function storing a new Transaction and incrementing transactionCount.

Changes dailyLimit; onlyWallet guarded.

Internal function resetting lastDay/spentToday and checking amount against dailyLimit with overflow guard.
Constant view returning the remaining daily withdrawable amount based on now and lastDay.
